purpose: Track the corrected remediation plan after forensic evidence showed the original 34-iteration estimate was not sufficient.

estimates.reason: The initial estimate undercounted real TypeScript migration, Style Dictionary multiplatform outputs, token ownership, anti-duplication governance, component/pattern/template 1:1 QA, and FlowDocs reconstruction as a consumer.

operatingRules: Do not advance phases unless the phase gate is explicit and recorded.
Do not count partial implementation as done unless it satisfies the original Definition of Done.
Report initial estimate, corrected estimate, and evidence when estimates change.
FlowDocs cleanup must wait for the underlying Flow contracts it is expected to consume.
No new docs visual behavior should be used as evidence that Flow itself is ready.

blockers: 7 docs generated candidates do not map to spec

outOfOrderWork.workDoneEarly: Primitive TS runtime/policy contracts were generated before fully closing Style Dictionary multiplatform outputs and TS migration phases.
outOfOrderWork.status: Useful but out of sequence; must not be used to claim later phases are complete.

phases.name: Baseline forense
phases.objective: Freeze current truth: inventory, duplication, docs-only, visual debt, token debt, TS debt, repos, commits, exports.
remaining: Consolidate existing reports into one baseline master with phase ownership and release risk.
Add commit/repo safety section as a tracked gate.

doneWhen: package exports point to generated declarations
No public JS surface ships with manual .d.ts as the only type story
TS governance blocks new public JS surfaces
remaining: Set up TypeScript project and build pipeline.
Migrate tokens/components contracts/shared helpers/core React components.

phases.objective: Make the base cascade exportable and consumable by higher layers.
doneWhen: Foundations are exportable contracts, not React components
Surface, Typography/Text, Stack/Grid/Layout, FocusRing, VisuallyHidden, Portal/Layer decisions are explicit
Primitive governance blocks doc-panel, local typography, fake surface, and gradients/textures outside source
remaining: Do not claim phase complete until TypeScript real and Style Dictionary outputs/governance are complete.
Add missing structural primitive decisions: Stack/Grid/Layout, FocusRing, VisuallyHidden, Portal/Layer if applicable.
Prove cascade consumption from components/patterns after TS migration.

phases.name: Components
phases.objective: Audit and type 60 components as consumable Flow components.
remaining: Start only after Style Dictionary and TS foundations are enforceable.

phases.name: Patterns
phases.objective: Make 63 patterns real, governed, and free of duplicate conceptual implementations.
doneWhen: Topbar/Sidebar/Search/Toolbar/Command Palette are typed and governed
No fake cards, raw overlays, search duplication, or DOM parallel behavior
remaining: P0.4 shell pattern contracts are next after returning to the master sequence.

phases.name: Templates
phases.objective: Make 9 templates consume real components and patterns.
remaining: Blocked until components and patterns are real.

phases.name: FlowDocs v2
phases.objective: Rebuild docs as a consumer of Flow rather than a parallel source.
remaining: Blocked by TypeScript real, components, patterns, templates, and docs ownership gates.
